assertions.name: Content_Info_ XML capture exists
assertions.query: exists ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it starts with "Content_Info_" and name of it ends with ".xml" and name of it does not contain "Admin_Tool" and size of it > 0)

assertions.name: Property_Info_ XML capture exists
assertions.query: exists ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it starts with "Property_Info_" and name of it ends with ".xml" and name of it does not contain "Admin_Tool" and size of it > 0)

assertions.name: Action_Info_ XML capture exists
assertions.query: exists ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it starts with "Action_Info_" and name of it ends with ".xml" and name of it does not contain "Admin_Tool" and size of it > 0)

assertions.name: Actionsite size is preserved in XML
assertions.query: exists lines whose (it contains "Actionsite Size:") of ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it starts with "General_Info_" and name of it ends with ".xml")

assertions.name: Root client relevance is preserved in XML
assertions.query: exists lines whose (it contains "Registration List Size:") of ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it starts with "Root_Server_Info_" and name of it ends with ".xml")

assertions.name: Property interval block is preserved
assertions.query: exists lines whose (it contains "Active Properties by Evaluation Interval") of ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it starts with "Property_Info_" and name of it ends with ".xml")

assertions.name: No failed query response is hidden
assertions.query: not exists lines whose (it contains "<Error>" or it starts with "ERROR:") of ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it ends with ".xml")

assertions.name: Optional human readable logs match selection
assertions.query: number of ((files of folders of folder "C:\BigFix_Master_Class\Platform\Results\Deployment_Information")) whose (name of it ends with ".log")
